transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this final production meeting started. We've got the draft plan for the video recording of the September 18 show at the Orpheum — four stagehands on a four-hour crew call, intended for internal archive only. Before I can approve it, I need the artist liaison and labor coordinator to confirm their respective areas. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a restriction on the draft plan. I received the artist's signed performance rider this morning. It permits an audio-only archival recording, prohibits any video recording, and requires the archive credit to read exactly 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set'. I have not attached the rider to the production file yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a restriction on the draft plan from my side as well. I confirmed with the theater's labor representative today that recording calls require exactly six stagehands and a minimum five-hour call under the local agreement. The staffing draft of four stagehands on a four-hour call was prepared before that confirmation and has not been revised.
transcript.speaker: A3
